# Projects

## ArztAgent

My most ambitious project to date, built with my brother. We’re building a phone agent for complex gastroenterology bookings and a shared practice inbox that automates routine requests across calls, email, and the patient portal. The codebase includes roughly 500,000 lines of Python as well as Rust components.

ID: proj-arztagent · 2026-07 · active

Tags: Python, Rust, Voice AI, Healthcare

[Project link](https://arztagent.app/)

## Live Notes

An open-source native macOS app that transcribes conversations locally with Whisper, captures Markdown notes, and lets you search and ask questions about your local files. You can also dictate rough ideas and turn them into a structured document.

ID: proj-live-notes · 2026-10 · active

Tags: Rust, macOS, Whisper, SQLite

[Project link](https://github.com/karma-works/live-notes)

[Demo](https://karma-works.github.io/live-notes/)

## Voice Assist

A voice-scheduling prototype for Google Calendar built with Gemini Live. General-purpose voice agents already handle personal bookings, leaving little room for a standalone product. The prototype was valuable for testing real-time voice, and OpenAI’s realtime models felt more responsive than Gemini Live in our experiments.

ID: proj-10 · 2026-06 · archived

Tags: Python, FastAPI, Gemini Live

[Project link](https://github.com/karma-works/voice-assist)

## Vert Finder

A trail discovery tool for combining hiking segments by elevation gain. The prototype came together quickly, but the use case did not show enough demand to sustain a public project.

ID: proj-11 · 2026-06 · archived

Tags: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS

[Project link](https://github.com/karma-works/vert-finder)

## SC2K City Viewer

Attempted open-source SimCity 2000 viewer using AI-generated tilemaps. Learned: AI struggles with systematic asset libraries requiring stylistic consistency.

ID: proj-5 · 2026-02 · archived

Tags: TypeScript, Python, Vite

# Project graveyard

## Voice Assist

A voice-scheduling prototype for Google Calendar built with Gemini Live. General-purpose voice agents already handle personal bookings, leaving little room for a standalone product. The prototype was valuable for testing real-time voice, and OpenAI’s realtime models felt more responsive than Gemini Live in our experiments.

2026-06 – 2026-11-21 · Python, FastAPI, Gemini Live

[Repository](https://github.com/karma-works/voice-assist)

## Vert Finder

A trail discovery tool for combining hiking segments by elevation gain. The prototype came together quickly, but the use case did not show enough demand to sustain a public project.

2026-06 – 2026-11-21 · React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS

[Repository](https://github.com/karma-works/vert-finder)

## Descend Into Darkness

Built blind-first from the wrong direction: a sighted platformer with sounds bolted on, not a game designed from audio principles up. WCAG AAA turned out to be the wrong compass — built for static pages, not real-time spatial navigation under pressure. Stereo wasn't enough for spatial understanding, AI wasn't a real sparring partner for blind UX, and Rex is still down there waiting for the real users who never came.

2026-05 – 2026-05 · TypeScript, HTML

[Repository](https://github.com/karma-works/descend-into-darkness)

## SC2K City Viewer

Killed by AI's inability to maintain stylistic consistency across 200+ pixel art tiles. The dream was noble, the execution... inconsistent.

2026-02 – 2026-02 · TypeScript, Python, Vite

[Repository](https://github.com/karma-works/sc2k-city-viewer)
